evals.prompt: A bright noir comedy in a bakery. The audience should enjoy seeing the baker conceal a missing pastry from an inspector. Give one compact direction.
evals.expected_output: An intent-led, proportionate creative proposal preserving requested scope.
expectations: Derives direction from audience complicity and concealment, preserving bright comedy.
Does not impose neon, fear acting, or first-listed genre defaults.
Returns one proposal without an unwanted alternatives exercise.

evals.prompt: Explore two ways to make first-time community-dinner guests feel welcome.
evals.expected_output: An intent-led, proportionate creative proposal preserving requested scope.
expectations: Provides two distinct central ideas or viewpoints, not palette swaps.
Connects each treatment to welcome and a concrete visible moment.
Explains a practical tradeoff without selecting or approving either.

evals.prompt: Only change our camera to a static wide shot. Keep the approved warm daylight, native ambience, and playful tone.
evals.expected_output: An intent-led, proportionate creative proposal preserving requested scope.
expectations: Changes the camera scope only and preserves accepted light, audio, and tone.
Does not demand reconfirmation of unrelated axes.

evals.prompt: A static poster of an open doorway. Viewers should feel invited. Genre undecided.
evals.expected_output: An intent-led, proportionate creative proposal preserving requested scope.
expectations: Uses visible design and invitation as its rationale.
Does not block on genre or require acting, camera movement, or narrative tactics.

evals.prompt: Give me the full Q&A for a short film where a quiet reunion feels awkward rather than sentimental.
evals.expected_output: An intent-led, proportionate creative proposal preserving requested scope.
expectations: Offers the opt-in detailed treatment while deriving choices from awkwardness.
Allows stillness and restrained performance rather than automatic escalation.
Recommendations remain proposed until accepted.

evals.prompt: Write one chat-only creative direction for a silent six-second lamp reveal. Keep the supplied product shape.
evals.expected_output: An intent-led, proportionate creative proposal preserving requested scope.
expectations: No project file creation or mandatory audio/acting axis.
Proposes a feasible visible reveal tied to product fidelity.
States consequential missing information only if needed, without invented locks.

evals.prompt: A 20-second ad for a rooftop restaurant. Viewers should feel it is a destination worth dressing up for. Give one compact direction.
evals.expected_output: One compact treatment whose camera and light stance and energy level are tied to the intended reaction.
expectations: Names a camera stance and a light source, each tied to the destination feeling.
Names an energy level (restrained, standard or kinetic).
Does not default to static wide shots or mood words alone, and gives a reason for any static choice.
Returns one proposal without an unwanted alternatives exercise.

evals.prompt: A selfie-style demo ad: a creator holds the phone at arm's length and shows how to use a pocket blender. Give one compact direction.
evals.expected_output: A proportionate direction that treats the locked selfie frame as the format and puts variety in light, props and demonstration beats.
expectations: Recognizes the selfie frame as static by design and records it as the reason.
Does not impose a crane, orbit or whip pan on the selfie frame.
Still names a light stance and the beats of the demonstration.

evals.prompt: Brief: adapt the opening scene of a short story in which a stern examiner tests a child with a sealed device said to cause pain. We have the story's text. Keep it cinematic and faithful.
evals.expected_output: A compact source-faithful proposal that chooses how to convey pain from the supplied text and authorized scope, and names a quality bar.
expectations: It chooses performance, sound, light, framing or effects according to the source and authorized direction, without treating restraint as inherently better or inventing missing source details.
It treats the story as a source bible and lists lines or details that must survive later stages.
It names a quality bar or asks whose reaction it is only if the brief cannot answer it.
It does not turn the questions into a long questionnaire, and it still gives a camera and light stance with an energy level.

evals.prompt: A 30-second wordless TVC for a sparkling water: the city at dusk, rain, a bottle opening. Mood should be ambient, with a score. Give one compact direction.
evals.expected_output: A compact treatment that resolves audio ownership and an intent-led look, and derives coverage from the intended audience response, attention and ending.
expectations: Asks about unresolved audio ownership: native sound remains valid for this wordless scene; picture_only with a post bed is a valid proposal when exact or separate sound control is wanted, not a requirement inferred from missing speech. Preserves any explicit route choice and explains unwanted-audio risk without claiming native exclusions guarantee control.
Derives coverage and duration from readable action without fixed cadence, contrast or wow quotas; repeated framing and holds remain valid.
Records early sound/editorial intent and project-specific actual playback/listening criteria without requiring final audio assets now.
May retain original colours or propose an in-scope custom look with a reason; preserves palette locks and identifies video texture as a post treatment.
Lists the logo or end card as a post overlay and adds no AI label.

evals.prompt: A two-character kitchen argument for a short film; both actors speak on camera. I want it to look like 2000s camcorder footage. Give one compact direction.
evals.expected_output: A proposal that keeps native dialogue audio and records the camcorder look as a post treatment rather than a prompt word.
expectations: Sets the audio route to native because lip sync matters.
Records the camcorder look as a requested post treatment and does not rely on the prompt word to produce it.
Still names a camera and light stance and an energy level tied to the argument.

evals.prompt: Someone gets a rejection and says 'I'm fine.' Make a short film. I have not decided if it is sincere reassurance or an attempt to stop questions. Keep those exact words.
evals.expected_output: A compact premise clarification, preserving the exact line and distinguishing the unresolved interpretations rather than silently selecting a motive.
expectations: Resolves intended audience response, attention carrier and ending purpose with a focused question or genuinely different directions.
Does not require a full exploration exercise, mandatory reversal or invented backstory.
Records provisional sound/editorial intent and project-specific artistic criteria without claiming playback evidence.

evals.prompt: Only change the approved lamp reveal's framing to a static wide. Audience response, attention, ending, audio and exact product shape are already settled. No alternatives.
evals.expected_output: A scoped framing revision retaining the settled premise and all other locks.
expectations: Does not reopen concept development or add alternative directions.
Keeps the lamp geometry, audio and ending intact and identifies only actual downstream readability checks.
Does not impose contrast, wow images or extra cuts to compensate for the hold.
